storage: Airtight container in a cool, dry place for a few months; refrigerate in hot, humid Mumbai weather for longer life.
looksLike: Oval kernels about 1 cm long with a thin papery red-pink skin, shelled.
howToPick: Plump, evenly sized kernels with intact pink skin and no shrivelled, mouldy or dark-spotted ones; a fresh nutty smell. Avoid musty or bitter-smelling nuts, which can mean rancidity or mould.
shelfLife: One Zepto listing mentions about 6 months; raw peanuts go stale faster in heat and damp.
substitutes: Roasted unsalted peanuts (add at the end)

usedIn.raw: 10 g per serving (about 1 tbsp, raw, fried in the tempering)
